glosses: Society that encourages the acquisition of goods and services in ever-increasing amounts.

The satisfaction that a consumer gets from the price they paid compared to what they were willing to pay over and above the current price, i.e. the difference between what they paid and what they were willing to pay.
A function that describes the relationship between consumption and disposable income.
A survey-based technique for the valuation of non-market resources, such as environmental preservation or the impact of externalities like pollution.
vi_hint: Định giá (hiện tượng) phát sinh; Việc định giá bất thường.

glosses: The set of points representing final allocations of two goods between two people that could occur as a result of mutually beneficial trading between those people given their initial allocations of the goods.
Tending to counteract the effects of the business cycle.
Inflation excluding the increase or decrease of prices in some transitory sectors (usually food and energy).
Inflation excluding energy, food, alcohol and tobacco prices.
A solution to a minimization or maximization problem where an interior solution is infeasible.
A tax levied on a corporation, especially on its profits; corporation tax.
A methodology to help appraise or assess the case for a project or proposal, by estimating the net cost or benefit of the project of proposal.
Any comparison of costs and benefits.
The average cost of a standard set of basic necessities of life, especially of food, shelter and clothing.
vi_hint: Chi phí cho sinh hoạt; Giá sinh hoạt.

glosses: A job or occupation carried out at home or on a part-time basis, historically often manufacturing work such as sewing, lacemaking, or spinning.
A small-scale industry, with relatively few employees or a limited customer base or low economic impact.
Dampening the cyclical fluctuations due to the business cycle in an economy.
Moving in the direction opposite to that of the overall state of an economy.
An exchange rate regime that allows depreciation or appreciation to happen gradually.
vi_hint: Chế độ neo tỷ giá hối đoái điều chỉnh dần.

glosses: A period of economic crisis in which credit and investment capital are difficult to obtain.
an economic metric that measures the responsiveness of the quantity demanded for a good to a change in the price of another good
vi_hint: Độ co giãn chéo của cầu.

glosses: The competition between countries in order to achieve a relatively low exchange rate for their home currencies, so as to assist their domestic industry.
A type of trade bloc which is composed of a free trade area with a common external tariff.
A type of unemployment explained by the demand for labor going up and down with the business cycle.
The limit up to which an entity (usually a government) is legally allowed to borrow.
